title: Output maps preserve event probabilities
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let a learning program on the $n$-dimensional sign cube have output space $A$, let $f:A\to B$ be any map, and let $T$ be a Boolean function on that cube. For every predicate $Q$ on $B$, the probability that the program obtained by applying $f$ to the output has output satisfying $Q$ equals the probability that the original program has output $a$ satisfying $Q(f(a))$.
hypotheses_covered: a Boolean target function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
a learning program with output type $A$
